evidence_maturity_legend.E1: Verified mathematical/behavioral invariant in local CI unit tests

adrs.organ: L0 字节输入与并行解码
adrs.core_mechanism: 无损字节流 + CanonCausalConv1D + Step-0 锁定 LZ77 表 + ATDC + LCA 4x 并行多字节解码
adrs.hardware_envelope: RTX 3050 4GB SM86 (CPU Step-0 LZ77 table, 0 extra VRAM)
adrs.rollback_trigger: 若本机实测吞吐落后紧凑字节 BPE >25% 则回退字节 BPE
adrs.challenger_or_reserve: `⚡扩展储备`：`FlashMap` ([2610.24365](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24365)，触发:高吞吐块草稿)、`PLMs` ([2610.26693](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26693)，触发:免草稿并行解码)、`dNaViT` ([2611.12426](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12426)，触发:多模态扩展)；`⚡扩展储备`：HMDLM ([2610.29255](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.29255v1))
adrs.rejected_or_redlines: `❌` 固定 BPE；训练后改分块规则

adrs.core_mechanism: OscillatoryDualDeltaNet (Mamba-3 梯形 + 复相位 + Rank-2 DeltaProduct + KalmaNet + LoReS + GateFloor) vs 同位挑战者 GSA2；推理期接入 `ReplaySSMCheckpointBuffer`（周期高精度检查点 + 输入缓冲 O(1) 指针回滚 + `DeltaLog` 延迟物化 + 防震荡熔断）
adrs.hardware_envelope: RTX 3050 4GB SM86 BF16; 500-step A/B PK pending GAP-10
adrs.rollback_trigger: 若 RTX 3050 500 步状态追踪不及纯 GDN 则简化去除冗余门控
adrs.challenger_or_reserve: `⚔️同位待PK`：`GSA2` 双边关联记忆 ([2610.02816](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02816)，已在 `src/experimental/` 落地代码)；`⚔️同位待PK`：`Kernel Ridge Attention (KRA)` ([2611.23896](https://arxiv.org/html/2611.23896)，31M 稀有召回 4× 于 GDN，已落地 `KernelRidgeAttentionChallenger`) & `SwiLA` ([2609.39034v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.39034v1))；`⚔️同位待PK`：Triadic Linear Attention ([2609.36529](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.36529v1))
adrs.rejected_or_redlines: `❌` 纯 Softmax Transformer；Rank-1 线性 RNN

adrs.organ: L1.2 精确召回、KV 剪枝与服务调度（25%）
adrs.core_mechanism: HoPE + MELT 共享 HLA + GateSightKVPruner(1/10 KV) + BOS Summary + SAW-INT4；服务期配 PrefixCacheMetastabilityBudgeter + Fairway + CISA + cμ
adrs.hardware_envelope: RTX 3050 4GB SM86 (Phase 1); Multi-session server GPU (Phase 3 Fairway/CISA)
adrs.rollback_trigger: 若 10% KV 保留掉点 >2% 则提升 GateSight 保留比例至 20%
adrs.challenger_or_reserve: `⚡扩展储备`：`TaSQ` 1-bit KV ([2610.03027](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03027)，触发:多并发)、`Fairway` ([2611.02082](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02082)，触发:高并发Prefill)、`cμ` ([2611.04807](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04807))、`CISA` ([2611.03200](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03200)，触发:1M上下文)
adrs.rejected_or_redlines: `❌` 全循环 BF16 KV；依赖注意力分数的 KV 驱逐；`⛔` 无驻留 KV 挂起预算的前缀缓存服务 ([2611.13412](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13412))；`⛔` 长链推理按注意力分数盲驱逐 KV ([2611.25433](https://arxiv.org/html/2611.25433))

adrs.organ: L1.3 循环深度、稀疏 FFN 与早停
adrs.core_mechanism: 8 轮共享循环核 + ARLoop + Birkhoff + FPRM/NE 早停 + LoopCD-Hidden + SGA-Sparse 原生 SwiGLU 稀疏 + GateFloor(SiLU+delta) + TAC-CoT 潜/工具交替
adrs.hardware_envelope: RTX 3050 4GB SM86 (T=8 recurrent passes, equivalent 36 layers)
adrs.rollback_trigger: 若 8 轮循环在 65M 上无逻辑增益则降为 4 轮以换取 2x 吞吐
adrs.challenger_or_reserve: `⚡扩展储备`：`TAC-CoT` 潜/工具交替 ([2611.01926](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01926)，触发:Phase 3 多工具链，前向 `-6.8×`)；`⚔️同位待PK`：INTACT ([2610.19568](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.19568))；`⚡扩展储备`：SPARE ([2610.29662](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.29662))
adrs.rejected_or_redlines: `❌` 全历史深度注意力；无早停固定深循环；⛔ `Causal-Geometric Latent Reasoning` (`2606.12689v2`) 警告：连续潜思考存在 Shortcut Behavior 与特征坍缩，需配置信度动态切换与上下文-预测融合 (`LT-Tuning`, `2602.10229v2`)

adrs.core_mechanism: LoopSpec 浅循环自推测（默认）+ BitNest 位嵌套共享权重推测（0.0 MB 额外草稿显存）
adrs.hardware_envelope: RTX 3050 4GB SM86 (0.0 MB extra draft VRAM)
adrs.rollback_trigger: 若 batch=1 端到端加速 <1.15x 则切回纯 LoopSpec
adrs.rejected_or_redlines: `❌` 独立草稿模型双份显存推测解码

adrs.organ: L1.4 优化器、内核与分布式
adrs.core_mechanism: PolarExpressMuonOptimizer + MuonQ INT8 + PyTorch Helion 编译期启发式 + GroupClip(FP64 解耦嵌入裁剪防静默丢步)；Scale-Up 配 EpiLoRA + Streaming DiLoCo

adrs.challenger_or_reserve: `⚡扩展储备`：`In-DRAM PUD` ([2611.02401](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02401)，触发:存算一体硬件)、`EpiLoRA` ([2611.03899](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03899)，触发:Hopper 48GB FP8 多LoRA)；`⚔️同位待PK`：Clean/Q-Clean ([2610.04204](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04204))、Mousse ([2610.18695](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.18695v1))；`⚔️同位待PK`：OPTScientist RS-MR ([2607.20486](https://arxiv.org/html/2607.20486v1))

adrs.organ: L1.7 后训练与 RLVR 范式
adrs.core_mechanism: Deletion Tuning vs 低秩 LoRA（65M 待 PK）+ GPPO + KAPPO + TRUER + CalibratedJudge + DialogGRPO；严禁有示范时冷启动 GRPO

reserve_admission_policy.rule: Any item entering ⚡扩展储备 MUST satisfy ALL 3 hard criteria; otherwise downgrade to 📜历史淘汰.
criteria: 1. Explicit Trigger Condition (hardware/scale/modality envelope where it activates)
2. Quantitative Bar (>=1.5x throughput/memory, >=+3pp quality, or >=2x comm/latency gain in target regime)
3. Orthogonal / Non-Destructive (zero invariant conflict or explicit replacement target)
